turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Hello, can you hear me okay?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes, a bit better if you face me.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Tell me what brought you in today.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I have had pressure in my chest since yesterday.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: When exactly did it start?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yesterday afternoon, around three.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Can you describe the pain for me?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: It feels like a heavy weight on my chest. I am really scared this is my heart, like my husband.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does it come on when you walk or climb stairs?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes, going up the stairs brings it on.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does anything make it better?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Resting helps a little.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you get sweaty or short of breath when it happens?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes, I get clammy and winded.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Have you ever fainted or felt like you might pass out?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Sorry, what did you say?

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you smoke, or have high blood pressure or high cholesterol?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I have high blood pressure. I have never smoked.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Has anyone in your family had heart trouble at a young age?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Not that I know of.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Have you had any heart problems or heart procedures before?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, I have never had any heart problems.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Before you go, here is the plan. First, come back to this clinic in one week. Second, bring your medicine bottles to your next visit.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Take care, and we will see you soon.
